summary: Python tests live in tests/ and cover the app package with a 90 percent coverage gate (pytest addopts and coverage fail_under). Web tests are Vitest under web/tests. Names below are the test functions and describe blocks present in those files.

nodes.role: Application imports stay inside the domain. Only LiteLLMRouterRuntime constructs litellm.Router. API routes do not import providers. Infrastructure does not import API. Bootstrap is the wire. Legacy flat modules are absent.
complete stage order and stream event order.
Catalog resolve, complete and stream, tools, cache and fallback, PII in and out, guards, schema, budget release on provider failure, identity-scoped memory.
HTTP health, chat JSON and SSE, memory routes, PII and guard status codes, schema errors, index HTML, CORS.
/v1 models, chat envelope, stream chunks, embeddings shape, identity budget and RPM on embeddings.
Native and OpenAI routes use a real ChatService.
OpenAPI path contract and admin methods.
Open mode, missing and wrong key, Bearer and X-Api-Key, compare_digest mismatch, CORS preflight allows Authorization.
Read cannot chat or patch. Chat can complete and list OpenAI models. Config scope for layer patch. Auth off skips scope checks.
List, create, patch, revoke. Admin scope required. Unknown key is 400.
Bootstrap from GATEWAY_API_KEY, CRUD, multi-key off uses legacy key, pepper required to store keys.
Env over dotenv and YAML, empty budgets, Langfuse host alias, secrets not in repr, provider keys stay in environ.
GET /config when auth is off. Patch forbidden without a gateway key. Patch does not mutate environ. Overlay survives reload.
Token and USD caps, file ledger skips cache hits, Redis ledger and file fallback, parallel reserve, record_usage replaces a reservation.
Per-identity token and USD budgets and HTTP enforcement.
In-process and Redis RPM windows. HTTP 429.
Configured and unconfigured modes, missing redis import, reachability cache.

Fallbacks, retries, cache, RPM/TPM, independent routers do not share a Router.

Off by default, redact, fail closed, spaCy engine build.
Parsers, fail closed, content ignore list, inbound scan of the memory blob, memory-write block.

429, 503, unmapped reraise, schema and guard payloads.
Request id, metrics opt-in and 404, identity metrics, route label uses the template.

complete() records preflight, provider, and postprocess.
Memory drain, lifespan, auth and pepper required at start, multi-worker without Redis refuses start.

NVIDIA key alias, Nemotron parsers, embedder dims.
Ollama detection requires a key. Host strips /v1.
Compose loopback and auth closed. Dockerfiles non-root with healthchecks. Requirements caps.
app.main exposes a FastAPI app.
Vitest covers pages, ConsoleShell, views, hooks, auth storage, gateway fetch, SSE parser, admin key client, formatters, and snippets.

notes: Fixtures live in tests/conftest.py, tests/factories.py, and tests/fakes.py. Their internals were not line-read for this map; behavior claims come from the test function names and from the pipeline and architecture files that were read.
CI runs pytest with PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 and TEST_REDIS_URL. pyproject addopts still loads pytest_cov so the 90 percent gate stays on.
Ruff checks app and tests, target py312, and excludes web.
Web coverage command is npm run test:coverage in web/.
